decisions.reason: The accepted contract replacement does not change the USDC payment currency, connected-wallet purchase method, or obligation to complete the NFT mint.
The decision does not change which payment methods must be disclosed, selectable, or disabled.
The contract replacement does not alter the deferred Transak provider, fiat-to-USDC flow, supported payment methods, or buyer profile.
The success-feedback rule remains that confirmation appears only after an actual NFT mint succeeds.
Starting with a replacement contract does not change the required minted asset or the obligation to fulfill a successful purchase with the NFT ebook.
Although the replacement contract restarts draws, the accepted decision does not change the current $15 mint price or revenue-allocation amounts.
The optional tipping behavior and its mint-page placement remain unchanged.
The contract replacement and reset of NFT numbering do not require a change to the supplied hero messaging.
The source does not direct an FAQ revision, and the existing general rules for mint numbers, referrals, payments, and rewards remain valid.

The client accepts using a new contract whose NFT numbering restarts at #1 while old-contract NFTs are excluded from the systems, necessarily narrowing displayed mint statistics to the new active contract.
